text:
maya: FYI seeing a jump in fncall validation rejects in ap-south since 08:17 UTC. Most failing reason = TOOL_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.
jon: Same here, saw a few 400s from customers. Is this the recent strict-validator rollout?
li: It hit 15% traffic in ap-south at 07:50 per the rollout. I thought only a small slice would be affected.
maya: Sampled payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "tool": "inventory_lookup",
  "response": {
    "available": true,
    "meta": []
  },
  "request_id": "r_zz987"
}
```
validator expects response.meta to be an object map, adapters sometimes return an empty array.
jon: That adapter path was changed in adapter v3.1 to default [] when no metadata. Regression?
li: I found the line. Quick patch to return {} instead of [] and a unit test. Will publish patch in ~10m.
maya: For console telemetry: can we add a Rejects by Validator table and expose the raw-sample link (permission-gated) on the reject row? Current sampling masks the field so it's hard to triage.
console-bot: deploybot: strict-validator canary enabled in ap-south at 07:50 UTC by li
ops: Temporarily enabling region-wide soft-validate for affected customers to prevent site errors. Noting this in incident board.
jon: Long term we should consider auto-fallback routing: if validator hard rejects exceed X% for Y minutes, route that shard to permissive variant. But we need an audit trail and opt-out per-customer.
li: Agree. Proposal: add a boolean rollout toggle in Console "auto-fallback-on-validator-spike" with threshold and cooldown. Ops can flip for emergencies.
maya: Also add a trace attribute validator.mode so we can quickly correlate rejects with rollout state. Right now traces don't carry that.
ops: We'll need RBAC for the raw-sample link and a retention policy (PII-safe). Suggest 1% of rejects retained for 7 days in secure bucket.
jon: Can we add two console metrics: soft_validate_count and hard_reject_count, plus a sparkline for region? That would make debugging faster.
li: Patch built and unit tested. Will cut release and coordinate rollback of soft-validate for impacted accounts after verification.
maya: Thanks. Please ping slack when patch is live and when you lift the temporary soft-validate.
ops: Created incident ticket #2487 "fncall-validator spike - ap-south" and assigned to eng-platform.
console-bot: opsbot: incident #2487 created and linked to alert "validator-hard-rejects-ap-south"
